title: 干扰项类型归因专项
passage: 干扰项类型归因专项训练：判断错误选项属于哪种干扰类型。

questions.question_text:
原文：The study found that 60% of participants improved after the treatment.
题目：What percentage of participants improved?
错误选项：About half of the participants showed improvement.

这个错误选项属于哪种干扰类型？
questions.analysis: 原文说的是 60%，选项换成了 half（50%），偷换了数字概念，属于偷换概念。

questions.question_text:
原文：The company reported a decline in sales last quarter.
题目：What can be inferred from the passage?
错误选项：The company will likely go bankrupt next year.

这个错误选项属于哪种干扰类型？
questions.analysis: 原文只说销售下降，选项推出公司即将破产，远远超出了原文信息，属于过度推理。

questions.question_text:
原文：The research focused on the effects of sleep on memory.
题目：What was the research about?
错误选项：The study examined how diet affects sleep quality.

这个错误选项属于哪种干扰类型？
questions.analysis: 原文根本没有提到 diet（饮食），选项内容完全是编造的，属于无中生有。

questions.question_text:
原文：Some experts believe that renewable energy is the key to solving climate change.
题目：What do experts think about renewable energy?
错误选项：All experts agree that renewable energy can solve climate change.

这个错误选项属于哪种干扰类型？
questions.analysis: 原文是 Some experts（一些专家），选项扩大成了 All experts（所有专家），以偏概全。

questions.question_text:
原文：The new policy had a positive impact on economic growth.
题目：What was the effect of the new policy?
错误选项：The policy slowed down economic development.

这个错误选项属于哪种干扰类型？
questions.analysis: 原文说 positive impact（积极影响），选项说 slowed down（减缓），意思完全相反，属于正反混淆。
